title: Personnel and approvals: staff every seat of every approval version under six cross-table rules
proves: eleven target tables with 30 columns and 540 rows come from pipe-separated data files, demand and one policy file; step 10 types each file once into the memstore and step 91 exports the stored rows
R1 to R3 decide each person per position; the evidence counts the exclusions by rule and names each near miss with its reason
a license is valid on its expiry date: person 47 is the only inspector for A07-V1 and expires on its date
the search needs backtracking: its first choice for A03-V1-PLN leaves A05-V1-PLN short (R6)
versions share their approval (A01) and approvals of one company share people (A03 and A04)
an infeasible demand ends below the budget as infeasible; a too small budget ends as budget_exhausted
step 90 checks R1 to R3 per seat from the raw rows and the step-10 positions, and R4 to R6 per position; it catches a broken search or a broken step 20 by name
a demand above max_seats stops a normal run in step 10

step 10 types the parameters of conf/policy.properties once into the policy product; a count that is not whole or a missing parameter stops the run, and an empty list or a two-item list with a space of exclusive approvals fails a named rule
the trace names the person, the rule and the reason of each rejection

each data variant changes one fact, each library variant breaks one check; Build rejects each with a diagnostic that names the rule, or a normal run stops with an error that names it (r4_above_maximum)
